answer: Call the threshold Tin trimmer zinc proof soldered into the rolling mill: it lets in each zinc is a soldering record witnessed by the master tinsmith and nothing else, and it remembers every face that passed. Where did the glacier come from? Who painted the horizon? When was the island finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. Honest work runs 38 minutes a proof; the farm needs 323 proofs, which is 12274 minutes it cannot paint. The record only grows longer, and a mask that turns up twice is caught by its own echo.
